method.unit: Unique affected element/rule occurrence or one independently reproduced interaction flow. This is not a count of independent implementation defects.
method.contrastDeduplication: atom number + visible child field index; the same element across filter modes, widths and online/offline runs counts once.
method.gridCount: 59 ambiguous tile names (34 walls, 25 empty cells), excluding five already-unique item names. Custom contextual naming check, not an axe failure.
method.focusCount: One Atom selection flow and one Grid movement flow, not 118 or 64 tiles.
method.excluded: Prior audit findings, PR #30 follow-up disclosure target fixes, fixture/test/CI additions and favorites aria-pressed synchronization are not added to the count.

validation.network: Local assets plus pinned public dataset only; all other external HTTP and WebSockets blocked, service workers disabled. Offline mode aborts the dataset request.
validation.sourceChecks: 154 script blocks/files, catalog, 55-page keyboard skip navigation, 11 Node test files, security core, localization/theme and combined Rules structural checks passed.
nativeInteractions: Favorites on/off and reset synchronize aria-pressed
Grid ArrowRight and Space retain player focus
Adjacent tile activation retains player focus
validation.ci: Added to the existing Desktop and touch UI regression job; new PR CI pending at report creation.
validation.browserSmoke: Existing desktop preferences, compact search, touch shortcut scrolling and blocked-storage browser regressions passed.

limitations: Only Atom/Grid states described here are newly covered; this does not assert the entire ecosystem is defect free.
Automated rules and native keyboard checks do not replace a screen-reader usability review.
Upstream periodic-table scientific data is not audited or changed.
